$comment: Canonical admin-access contract examples (docs/API.md v1.4 §3.18, §3.15, §3.10/§3.14 demo_clock, §4.3, §4.9a). Loaded by the edge (pytest), cloud (pytest) and kiosk (node) suites. Values are illustrative, not measured. Placeholders in <angle brackets> are never real secrets; the override codes below are fake examples and are never valid in any bundle.
generated_from: config/schedule.demo.json roles / zones / kiosks (role_defaults are the master values)

how_to_test.valid_examples: request.body must validate against the side's request model; response.body must parse into the side's response model / kiosk parser with no field lost or invented. response.fragment=true means only the keys shown are normative (GET /v1/mode).
how_to_test.error_examples: request_invalid=true: the request model (body, meta or path pattern) MUST reject request.body / path_params. request_invalid=false: the request is model-valid; the error comes from state (named in `state`). Compare status, error.code and error.reason only; message and details[].msg are informative text.
how_to_test.edge_request_shape: request.path_params fills the {placeholders} of path; request.query is the query string; multipart routes give request.meta (the JSON `meta` part) and request.frames (number of JPEG parts).

role.must_be: a role of the cloud master (edge pre-checks the installed bundle's role names)

zone.must_be: a zone of the cloud master (checked by the cloud; the edge bundle is filtered to the kiosk's zone)

field_limits.valid_from_until: ISO-8601 with offset; valid_until > valid_from; null clears

OFFLINE.meaning: writes: forced OFFLINE, or connectivity OFFLINE (reason other than bundle_stale); refresh: forced OFFLINE only (a refresh is attempted while connectivity is OFFLINE, L3)

NOT_CONFIGURED.meaning: CLOUD_API_URL empty or no cloud admin token

CLOUD_ERROR.meaning: transport error / timeout / cloud 401 or 5xx; also a refresh attempted while connectivity is OFFLINE (not forced) that fails (L3)

ENDPOINT_NOT_DEPLOYED.meaning: cloud 404 without error.reason, or 405: the cloud build lacks the route

ERASED_IN_BUNDLE.where: PUT access without consent:true; POST /v1/enroll while the erasure is in the installed bundle

USER_REVOKED.where: 409 on PUT access (consent:true without restore:true); 403 on POST /v1/enroll

CODES_UNAVAILABLE.where: cloud codes/rotate (the edge reports it as CLOUD_ERROR)
